trust_center.repositoryDescription: The Cursor FedRAMP Trust Center provides public program information and access to controlled security and compliance materials.
trust_center.accessRequestInstructions: Public program information is viewable without an account. To request controlled materials, select Request Access on the Cursor FedRAMP Trust Center and identify your agency or organization. Existing authorized reviewers may use their approved Cursor assessment workspace. For assistance, email fedramp@cursor.com from an official account. Public offering metadata is available as JSON at https://cursor.com/fedramp/certification-package-overview.json.

secure_configuration_guidance.repositoryDescription: Public guidance for configuring identity, privacy, agent controls, network access, extensions, and monitoring for a secure Cursor deployment.

certified_services.serviceDescription: Cursor IDE is a desktop code editor with AI-assisted code generation, review, navigation, and agent workflows built into the development environment.
Cursor Agent CLI provides an interactive and headless coding agent in the terminal for writing, reviewing, and modifying code.
Cursor Cloud Agents execute software development tasks in isolated cloud development environments and support parallel, long-running, scheduled, and event-driven workflows.
Cursor SDK provides programmatic access to the Cursor agent runtime for launching, steering, and composing agents in local and cloud environments.
Grok Bot provides AI teammates that work across connected tools using isolated cloud computers, carry tasks from start to finish, and continue working when users are away.
Bugbot reviews source code changes in supported source control systems, reports potential defects, and can propose fixes through Cursor agent workflows.
Security Agents review pull requests and scan codebases for security bugs, risky patterns, and vulnerabilities using Cursor-managed agents that run on Cloud Agents.
PR Routing & Approval routes pull requests to reviewers and approves low-risk changes when configured approval criteria are met.
Enterprise Administration provides organization and team management, identity and access controls, policy enforcement, usage and spend controls, audit and compliance logging, and administrative APIs.

current.service_desc: Cursor is an AI-powered software development platform that helps developers and organizations understand, generate, review, and maintain software. The offering includes the Cursor editor, AI-assisted development workflows, and related cloud services. Anysphere, Inc. is pursuing FedRAMP 20x Class C certification for the Cursor platform, and A-LIGN confirmed on October 22, 2026 that its assessment work was complete. Cursor became FedRAMP Certified under the 20x Program Class A (Pilot) profile on October 29, 2026, as recorded on the FedRAMP Marketplace. The Class C request remains under FedRAMP review. Origin, Cursor's Git hosting product, is not part of this offering and is not offered to FedRAMP customers; service capabilities that operate on Origin repositories are outside the assessed scope.
